purpose: What Operational Mapping should resolve from this fixture. Mapping is the surface that stays inert on a fixture with no resource Groups and no task custom fields, which is why this fixture exists and why its expectations are recorded rather than discovered.

extended_attributes.explanation: Area on all 48 tasks, Discipline on the 8 discipline summaries and their 32 work tasks, Permit Type on the 24 work tasks where it is non-blank. Text4 carries a value on 8 tasks and contributes none of these: an extended attribute with no Alias is dropped by the extractor, so 112 rather than 120 is the assertion that the alias filter is real.

notes: One resource carries no Group at all. The extractor skips a null or blank value rather than storing an empty string, so that resource contributes no 'group' key and the mapping SQL sees nothing for it.

One group-carrying resource has no assignment. Group resolution joins assignments to resources, so it contributes no task values -- a mapping that read groups without that join would wrongly include it.
Two work tasks carry assignments from two different groups, which is the multi-valued case a single-value mapping would silently truncate.
Permit Type is blank on 8 of the 32 work tasks. A blank value is not stored, so a category resolved from it should report those tasks as unmapped rather than as mapped to an empty string.
Every task sits under exactly one area summary, so an ancestor mapping at outline level 1 resolves all 48.
Text-only expectations. No generated artifacts, no real project data, and no schedule calculation by Shutdown Tracker.
